=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1100 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex is too strictly anchored, so multi-line or explanatory success messages will not match.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged the same anchored `grep`/regex regression; severity is highest where stated and the finding is consistent across reviewers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~186 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `jq` parsing of the commit message can yield an unexpected `null`/field-shift case for empty input.
  WHY: This was flagged only by one reviewer, and no other reviewer confirmed it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~195-196 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Bash `${var,,}` lowercase conversion is not portable to Bash 3.2.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding with no corroboration from the other reviews.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~201 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: Bash `${var,,}` lowercase conversion is not portable to Bash 3.2.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding with no corroboration from the other reviews.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3861-3865 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit guard can skip follow-up verification without explicitly checking that the commit is an `[ai-autofix]` commit.
  WHY: Two reviewers described the same skip-logic concern; one reviewer considered it already safe, so severity/confidence reflect the highest reported concern and the disagreement.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~92 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Copying the entire `CODEX_HOME` into a temp directory can exhaust runner disk space.
  WHY: The same bulk-copy risk was flagged by two reviewers with matching root cause.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:115-121 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` is not portable between GNU and BSD `sed`.
  WHY: Three reviewers flagged the same portability issue over the same block; one reviewer reported the fix was already applied, so the consensus keeps the shared concern and highest severity/confidence.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~128-132 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The consolidator invocation omits the read-only sandbox flags used elsewhere.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding with no corroboration from the other reviews.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:752-755 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Numeric comparisons can fail when the compared values are empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the same comparison fragility in the ledger updater.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:985-1022 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: Numeric comparisons can fail when the compared values are empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding covering the later comparison blocks; no other reviewer confirmed that exact location range.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:883 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Forcing `--sandbox read-only` may block reviewer tools that need writable local state.
  WHY: Two reviewers reported the same sandbox trade-off at the reviewer invocation site.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~201 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Bash 4+ `${var,,}` syntax incompatible with older Bash versions.
  WHY: On older Bash versions, `${var,,}` causes a `bad substitution` error.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3861-3865 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The post-commit guard does not verify the commit is actually `[ai-autofix]`.
  WHY: A non-autofix commit could incorrectly skip the follow-up verification pass.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1100 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex requires the success phrase to be on a standalone line.
  WHY: Anchoring with `^` and `$` causes explanatory or multi-line success messages to miss the no-op match.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:115 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` is not portable across GNU and BSD `sed`.
  WHY: BSD `sed` requires an explicit backup suffix, so the current form can fail or misparse.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:102 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Copying the entire `CODEX_HOME` can exhaust disk space.
  WHY: A large accumulated `CODEX_HOME` may exceed temporary runner quotas.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:883, 140, 141 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `--sandbox read-only` can block tools that need to write temporary files.
  WHY: Reviewer tools may need writable intermediate state for analysis.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:752, 985, 1015 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Numeric comparisons fail when variables are empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: Shell comparisons like `-gt` error on empty values.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:190-192 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Tab-separated parsing with `cut` could be confused by tab characters in input fields.
  WHY: A tab in input could disrupt the TSV parsing.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: `if grep -qEi '^([[:space:]]*([-[:space:]]*)?)?...$'` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new success-no-op regex is too strictly anchored with `^` and `$`.
  WHY: Introductory or explanatory text alongside the success keywords will not match, causing the workflow to miss the no-op case.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh: `sed -i -e "s/.../.../" "${cfg}" 2>/dev/null || true` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` without a backup suffix is not portable between GNU and BSD `sed`.
  WHY: On BSD-based systems, the command can fail or misparse arguments and break config patching.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh: `cp -r "${CODEX_HOME}/." "${consolidator_codex_home}/"` | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unchecked bulk copy of `${CODEX_HOME}` to `/tmp`.
  WHY: Large accumulated state can exhaust runner disk space during consolidation.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh: `exec "${codex_bin}" --ask-for-approval never exec --model "${model}" --sandbox read-only < "${prompt_file}"` | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Forcing a `read-only` sandbox may block reviewer tools that require write access.
  WHY: If a reviewer needs intermediate files or backend writes, the sandbox will cause failures.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh: `if [[ "${value}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "${value}" -gt "${header_last_updated}" ]` | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Numeric comparison is fragile if `value` is empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: Unexpected header corruption or parsing edge cases could still lead to shell comparison problems.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: 11103 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The modified regex with `^` and `$` anchors is more restrictive than before and can miss success-no-op messages that include explanatory text.
  WHY: The old regex matched the success phrase anywhere in output, but the new one requires the entire line to match.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh: 115 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: GNU-specific `sed -i` without backup suffix is not portable to BSD/macOS `sed`.
  WHY: BSD `sed` requires `-i ''`, so the current form can fail on non-GNU environments.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh: 92 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Copies the entire `CODEX_HOME` directory to temp without size checks.
  WHY: Long-running runs can accumulate enough data to exceed runner disk quotas.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh: 750-755, 986-994, 1031-1040 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Numeric validation is fragile when values are empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: Edge cases around empty strings remain possible despite the regex guard.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh: 883 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Running reviewers with `--sandbox read-only` can block tools that need write access.
  WHY: Reviewer logic that creates intermediate files or caches may fail under the read-only sandbox.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~186 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `jq` `split("\n")[0]` can produce an unexpected `null`/field-shift case for empty input.
  WHY: The TSV output may contain `null` instead of an empty string, which can break downstream parsing.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~195-196 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Bash `${var,,}` lowercase conversion is not portable to Bash 3.2.
  WHY: Older Bash versions can throw `bad substitution` and abort the script.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3861-3865 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger guard does not verify that the commit subject starts with `[ai-autofix]`.
  WHY: Any successful commit could skip the follow-up verification pass.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1103 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The anchored success-no-op regex misses success messages that include additional text.
  WHY: Explanatory or multi-line messages will not match, causing false negatives and redundant re-issues.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~117-121 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` is not portable between GNU and BSD `sed`.
  WHY: BSD `sed` requires an explicit backup suffix, so the current command can fail or misparse.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~128-132 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The consolidator invocation lacks the `--ask-for-approval never` and `--sandbox read-only` flags.
  WHY: Without the sandbox flags, consolidation may mutate the workspace or behave inconsistently with other reviewer invocations.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:750-755, 986-994, 1031-1040 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Numeric validation is fragile when values are empty or non-numeric.
  WHY: The checked comparisons still rely on shell numeric operators that are sensitive to malformed input.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== END FINDINGS FROM last_end ===
